context: A senpai and a teen chat
purpose: Teach: 些細/年中/最期/人前/一夜/ほしく/濃く/くさい

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 桜、些細な悩み、相談していいぞ。
lines.en: Sakura — you can talk to me about anything that's on your mind, no matter how small.
lines.style: Warm opening, inviting but not effusive. Slight lean-in with genuine availability. Measured pace—not rushing, giving her space to accept. Natural mentor ease, not performing the role.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。先輩、年中、頼りになります。
lines.en: Thank you. You've always been someone I can count on, senpai.
lines.style: Sincere and direct, meeting his generosity without over-performing gratitude. Steady voice, respectful but not stiff. A quiet acknowledgment of trust established over time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 卒業発表の最期、自分の言葉、入れたい。
lines.en: For the graduation presentation ending, I want to put in my own words.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to himself. Slight hesitation—testing the idea aloud. Softer attack on the opening. Genuine uncertainty underneath, not delivering a directive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 人前で話す経験、増やしたいです。
lines.en: I'd like to get more experience speaking in front of people.
lines.style: Careful, respectful phrasing. Quiet determination underneath politeness. Even pace, no rush. She's naming something she wants without apologizing for it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一夜で書き上げた論文、後で見直そう。
lines.en: The paper I wrote in one night—we should look over it again later.
lines.style: Self-aware, slightly rueful. Dry humor without bitterness. Acknowledges the shortcut taken without dwelling. Light, practical tone—moving forward.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩のメモ、ほしくなって、参考にしました。
lines.en: I ended up wanting your notes so badly I used them as a reference.
lines.style: Bright admission without embarrassment. Small laugh underneath. Warm toward him—not hiding that his work helped. Open, genuine, a little sheepish.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: コーヒー、濃く頼んだ、徹夜用に。
lines.en: I ordered a really strong coffee to get through the all-nighter.
lines.style: Self-deprecating, tired-amused. Acknowledges the poor planning with a small, knowing smile. Pace picks up slightly—wry energy. Like he's in on the joke with himself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 研究室、たまにくさい時、ありますよね、薬品の匂い。
lines.en: The lab gets pretty smelly sometimes, doesn't it—with all the chemical odors.
lines.style: Observant, reflective, trailing off gently. Not complaining, just noticing. Quiet intimacy—the shared environment. Inviting him to notice it too. Soft closeout.
